name: Indicators
description: State indicators: screen recording, night light, do not disturb, stay awake and screensaver hold show while on; hovering reveals the others dimmed; a click toggles one. Entries another bar widget already shows (pager, idle, privacy) are left out

items.description: Which indicators to show, in order: ScreenRecording, NightLight, Dnd, StayAwake, Screensaver; empty shows all

alwaysShow.description: Show inactive indicators (dimmed) without waiting for hover
